text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh… Fsshhh…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Wait… You want to talk… about my friend?
choice_data_list: Yes, I want to know more about her.
Yes, I want to know more about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, I ask Manhattan Cafe about the entity that's had such a huge influence on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember overhearing something in the past. If I recall correctly…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …The one who looks like me… She's my friend, and I've known her since I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …She's led me here, but I can't let her outrun me much longer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So Manhattan Cafe has known her friend since childhood. But what does she mean her friend "leads" her?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What would you… like to know?
choice_data_list: You said your friend "leads" you. What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She leads me because… she's always running ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Actually, that's not quite right. She does more than that…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My friend… takes me to happy places…
Hehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: To quiet places no one knows about… She shows me in secret…
Hehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: At the amusement park… she sat right on top of the ferris wheel. I followed after her in a carriage… The view was beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: When I chase after my friend, I always find something fun…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And if I ask, she always tells me where to go…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one else ever helped me out… but my friend was different.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She was the only one… who made me happy. She was the only one…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well… I hadn't thought about that. You're a little like her now too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But I only met you because she led me to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm starting to get it. Her friend isn't just some figure running ahead of her in races…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To Manhattan Cafe, her friend is a kind of guide to happiness.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Even now, she takes me anywhere I ask her to. For example…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I want you to try thinking of something that would be impossible to find in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something impossible to find… And her friend is going to take us to it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An idea pops into my head. I suggest…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Lavender… The Lavandula plant of the Lamiaceae family… It doesn't grow around here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But if we wish for it from the bottom of our hearts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A powerful force pushes me from behind. I break out in a cold sweat as I head in the direction it compels me to go…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A boulder… Let's move it out of the way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: On the count of three. One, two… nnngh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe channels her strength into her slender arms, and we push the boulder aside. And in its place…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's a bunch of… seagrass. Each blade has a cluster of flowers at the top…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Is this supposed to be a stand-in… for the lavender we wished for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is probably the best her friend can do. I think it's safe to assume that she's not omnipotent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's like a guardian spirit who does whatever's in her power to help.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Marimo… Spherical clumps of algae that live in places like Hokkaido's Lake Akan…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I doubt we'll find any in the area, but if we wish for it from the bottom of our hearts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A powerful force pushes me from behind. I break out in a cold sweat as I head in the direction it compels me to go…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… We've walked… quite a long way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh? There's something washed up on the shore…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a… ball of seaweed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A rounded clump of plant life that's died after absorbing so much of the ocean's polluted water…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's not very appealing to look at… but perhaps this is… a stand-in for the marimo we wished for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is probably the best her friend can do. I think it's safe to assume that she's not omnipotent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's like a guardian spirit who does whatever's in her power to help.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is how she guides me… straight to happiness.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's always by my side, helping me… My dear friend…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps Manhattan Cafe made it to where she is now thanks to this guardian spirit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Look. There's a small island off in the sea…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm a little curious… I imagine it's a wonderful, tranquil place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look out to the ocean and see the island. But it's not within swimming distance, and there's no bridge or boat in sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we really want to see it for ourselves, we'll have to…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suddenly feel several shoves from behind! It's as if I'm being urged to go ahead without hesitating.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, my friend is… waving at us…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's telling us to head toward her, across the water…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's like a guardian spirit. And yet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't tell if she has any intention of protecting us.
